Name: Lemonlimeneko's Baron Munchington Portrait Mod
Author: Lemonlimeneko
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8hCitiM.png[/img]

I was thoroughly enjoying [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16383]Nyapu's Portraits[/url] of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] when I noticed that Baron Munchington wasn't included.  For consistency, I decided to create this portrait mod in a similar style as to Nyapu's.  However, after many hours, I decided that I was not going to be able to figure out a way to code content patcher and custom patcher together in a pack to replace the portrait in the [CC] section of East Scarp.  For now, you will have to add the image file manually yourselves.  I might give it another go if someone from the team of East Scarp reaches out to me!




[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZzJxwWY.png[/img]

1. Download this mod.

2. Enter your mod folder.  Within the mods folder, there should be your East Scarp folder,  then [CC] East Scarp Critters, then companions, and finally click the Munchboi folder.  Path should resemble this: {East Scarp\[CC] East Scarp Critters\Companions\Munchboi}.

3. Drag the portrait.png file you downloaded into the Munchboi folder and allow it to replace the portrait file within it.

P.S. it is always a good precaution to make a backup of the East Scarp mod folder or of the original portrait file in case you want to change it back.  Even if you don't have that, you can re-download the mod from its respective page.
